title: The Claws Come Calling
summary: After Pisces, the Tyger Claws come for Lizzie's, and Judy calls V to hold the street with her.
description: The Tyger Claws have sent word that they are coming to wreck Lizzie's Bar tonight. Judy is scared, she will not leave her workshop, and she calls V to hold the street with her.

start.bringUp: The Tyger Claws sent a message that they are coming to wreck Lizzie's tonight. Bring up, in your own way, that you are scared and you need V there, and that you are not leaving your workshop.

front.name: the street in front of Lizzie's Bar

door.name: the inside of Lizzie's front door

sign.name: the sign over Lizzie's front door

J4.call.01.text: V. Susie got a message. The Claws are coming for Lizzie's. Tonight.

J4.call.02.text: Because of the Clouds. Because of everything.

J4.call.03.text: I'm not leaving my workshop. I'm not much in a fight, but I'm not leaving.

J4.hold.01.text: You came. Okay. Okay. Mox are inside, I'm at the door.

J4.hold.02.text: I've got a pistol and a really bad attitude. That's the plan.

J4.hold.04.text: On foot, three of them, from the corner!

J4.hold.08.text: That one's big. That one's really big.

J4.hold.09.text: ...Is it over? Tell me it's over.

J4.after.01.text: Walk with me. I need to see it.

J4.after.02.text: The sign's shot through. Rox is going to have a stroke.

J4.after.03.text: It's not the Claws I'm mad at. Not really.

J4.after.04.text: Thank you. I'm really bad at saying that, so I'm saying it twice. Thank you.

J4.end.01.text: Susie says you drink free here. Forever. I said that's a lot of drinks.

J4.end.02.text: Nobody died. That's the part I'm holding on to.

J4.end.03.text: We're okay. The bar isn't. I'm okay. I'm fine. I'm okay.

J4.fix.01.text: Repainting. Come hold a brush if you want.

g1.asks: Have you done this before? Hold a place?
g1.know: The Claws are coming in waves, the bar's layout, and two Mox fighters inside with you.
g1.secret: She is shaking, and her pistol is not loaded properly. She will say so if V asks.

g2.asks: Did I do the right thing at Pisces? You were there.
g2.know: What V chose at Pisces, from the save's facts.
g2.secret: Maiko, and how much it still hurts.

stages.label: Judy calls V: the Claws are coming for Lizzie's
stages.objective: Answer Judy's call about the Tyger Claws at Lizzie's Bar
stages.know: Susie Q got a message that the Tyger Claws are coming to Lizzie's tonight, because of the Clouds and because of what happened at Pisces.
stages.wants: V to get to Lizzie's street before the Claws do.

stages.label: Hold Lizzie's street against the Tyger Claws
stages.objective: Hold the street outside Lizzie's Bar with Judy
stages.know: Three waves of Tyger Claws are coming: three on foot, three from a car, then two with a heavier fighter. Judy is inside the door with a pistol, and two Mox fighters are with you.
stages.wants: V to hold the street and keep the Claws out of Lizzie's.

stages.label: Judy and V walk the street after the fight
stages.objective: Walk the street outside Lizzie's with Judy
stages.know: The Claws are gone. You and V are walking the street to look at the damage, and the workshop is fine.
stages.wants: V to walk with you and see what the Claws did.

held.memory: You held Lizzie's street with Judy against the Tyger Claws after Pisces, and nobody on your side was lost.
held.history: The Mox at Lizzie's give you free drinks for life, since you held the street with Judy.

wrecked.memory: The Claws wrecked the front of Lizzie's even with you there. Nobody died, and Judy holds on to that.
